name: Weighted Triceps Dip
steps: While standing, fasten the plate to a dip belt and check that its attachment is closed.
Take the dip handles, rise onto straight arms and steady the plate with your chest upright.
Bend your elbows straight back close to your ribs to lower your body smoothly until your upper arms reach roughly parallel to the floor.
Press down to straighten your arms and dismount under control before detaching the plate.
tips: Keep your torso upright and elbows tucked to keep the emphasis firmly on your triceps.
Stop lowering before your shoulders roll forward or feel pinched under load.
